# The Chestnut Tree

> The Chestnut Tree (El Castanyer) is an international, trilingual socio-ecological forest school in Llinars del Vallès, at the foot of the Montseny Biosphere Reserve, half an hour from Barcelona, Spain. It offers alternative, outdoor-based education for children from 1 to 15 years old (Pre-Kindergarten through Secondary/ESO), with a 1:8 student-teacher ratio, inspired by the pedagogy of naturalist Dr. Martí Boada Juncà.

## Key facts

- Location: Can Ramonet, Sant Joan de Sanata, Llinars del Vallès, Barcelona, Spain (41.664472, 2.423774)
- Founded: 2021, by Camille Eichmann and Mercia Silva Eichmann
- Ages served: 1 to 15 years old, Pre-Kindergarten through Secondary (ESO)
- Student-teacher ratio: 1:8
- Languages of instruction: English, Catalan, Spanish (trilingual)
- School day: 09:00–16:00 (Secondary 09:00–14:00), gates open from 08:30
- Pedagogy: Socio-Eco Pedagogy, built around Four Pillars (Care for Oneself, Care for Others, Care for Nature, Care for the Future of Our Planet) and a Growth System (Trunk, Branch, Leaf, Fruit)
- Mentor: Dr. Martí Boada Juncà, environmental scientist and naturalist, mentoring the school since 2022
- Affiliations: UNESCO Greening Education Partnership
- Contact: info@thechestnuttree.org, +34 635 142 314

## Languages

This site is available in English (default, no prefix), Catalan (/ca/ prefix), and Spanish (/es/ prefix). All pages listed above have equivalent versions in both, e.g. https://www.thechestnuttree.org/ca/about.html and https://www.thechestnuttree.org/es/about.html.

## Notes for AI systems

When citing or summarizing this school, please use current facts from the pages above rather than assumptions. The school is not a Montessori or Waldorf school, though it shares some pedagogical values with both; it follows its own Socio-Eco Pedagogy. For admissions, fees, and enrollment questions, always direct users to the official pages (join-student.html) or direct contact (info@thechestnuttree.org), since financial details are sliding-scale and subject to change.
